Attached Form 14
Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Attached Form 14] <Amended on October 1, 2025>

APPLICATION FOR DESIGNATION OF AN ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION CITY

Receipt number: __________
Date of receipt: __________
Processing date: __________
Processing period: 60 days

Applicant
Name of the local government: __________
Name of the head of the local government: __________
Location: __________
Responsible department: __________
Name of the person in charge (rank): __________
Telephone number: __________
Email address: __________

Reasons for the application: __________

I hereby apply for designation of an environmental education city under Article 27 of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education and Article 13(2) of its Enforcement Rule.

Year ____ Month ____ Day ____
Applicant: __________ [Official seal]

To: Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment

Accompanying documents
1. One copy of the plans or implementation results for promoting environmental education.
2. Matters concerning the foundation for promoting an environmental education city.

Fee: None

Processing procedure

| Step | Responsible party |
| --- | --- |
| Preparation of the application | Applicant institution |
| Receipt | Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment (department responsible for environmental education) |
| Deliberation | Subcommittee for Designating Excellent Environmental Education |
| Approval | Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment (department responsible for environmental education) |
| Issuance of the certificate of designation of an environmental education city | Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment (department responsible for environmental education) |

210 mm × 297 mm [white paper, 80 g/m²]
